title: Kanye West is currently in Spain undergoing treatment at a retreat, accompanied by his wife Bianca Censori, according to new court records
description: Kanye West and Bianca Censori are undergoing treatment at The Balance Rehab Clinic in Mallorca, Spain, a luxury retreat specializing in addiction, mental health, and couples therapy. The retreat aims to help high-profile clients in a private setting. The couple's stay has focused on couples therapy to repair their relationship and improve their mental well-being amid personal challenges, with Kanye continuing treatment as per doctor's orders.
content_summary: Kanye West and his wife Bianca Censori have been staying at The Balance Rehab Clinic in Mallorca, Spain, which offers luxury rehabilitation combining mental health recovery, addiction treatment, and couples therapy. The retreat, designed for high-profile clients, features amenities like ocean views, gourmet meals, spa treatments, and specialized therapy sessions. Their therapy focused on repairing their marriage amid public and personal struggles. Bianca initiated the retreat despite initial reluctance from Kanye. According to court records, Kanye's treatment continues until the end of May to address ongoing health concerns. The therapy has reportedly improved their relationship dynamics and mental wellness, signaling a positive turn in their marriage. The exact details of their treatment remain private, with speculation on rest and recalibration being part of the process.

title: At Cannes 2025, Aishwarya Rai skillfully avoided a wardrobe malfunction on the red carpet when Helen Mirren accidentally stepped on her flowing cape on day 2 of the festival
description: During Cannes 2025 day 2, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan wore a stunning black gown with a flowing cape. A moment of potential wardrobe malfunction occurred when Helen Mirren accidentally stepped on the cape. Aishwarya handled the situation gracefully, maintaining poise and elegance, avoiding any mishap on the red carpet.
content_summary: At the Cannes Film Festival 2025, on the second day, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan dazzled in a black gown by Gaurav Gupta, adorned with silver and gold beadwork. The gown had a long flowing cape that was accidentally stepped on by Helen Mirren, creating a moment that could have led to a wardrobe malfunction. Aishwarya's poise and quick composure averted the incident gracefully, showcasing her professionalism and stature as a red carpet icon. The incident was met with admiration from fans and observers alike, praising her calm recovery and dignified presence during the event.

title: The surprise London gig by the band Kneecap, occurring a day after a terror charge, sold out in just 90 seconds. Lead singer Mo Chara made light of the situation on stage
description: Kneecap held a surprise London show at the 100 Club one day after their lead singer, Mo Chara, was charged with a terror offense. The gig sold out in 90 seconds, and Mo Chara appeared on stage with tape over his mouth as a statement. The band addressed the political implications of the charge and continued to perform despite controversy and police presence.
content_summary: The Belfast rap group Kneecap staged a surprise gig in London at the 100 Club shortly after lead singer Mo Chara was charged with a terror offense. The event swiftly sold out, reflecting strong fan support despite the legal controversy. Mo Chara's stage appearance, with tape on his mouth, symbolized censorship and political persecution. The band criticized the charges as politically motivated, using the platform to highlight broader issues beyond their case. Police maintained security during the performance, with no incidents reported. The band is also slated for future performances despite calls for their removal from festivals.

title: Taylor Swift's subpoena was dropped by Justin Baldoni in a surprising development in his legal case against Blake Lively, freeing Swift from appearing in court
description: Taylor Swift was freed from a subpoena in the legal dispute between Justin Baldoni and Blake Lively after Baldoni's legal team received the necessary documents, making Swift's court appearance unnecessary. The lawsuit involves claims of defamation and extortion surrounding the film 'It Ends with Us'. Swift's role in the dispute was denied by her representatives.
content_summary: In the ongoing legal battle between Justin Baldoni and Blake Lively, Taylor Swift was subpoenaed due to allegations related to the film 'It Ends with Us'. However, the subpoena was dropped after Swift's legal team voluntarily provided the requested information, negating the need for her court appearance. The lawsuit includes claims of defamation and extortion, with Swift's team denying her involvement in the film's production. The case continues with the trial set for March 2026. Swift's release from the subpoena was welcomed by Lively's representatives as a relief from unnecessary harassment.

title: Alia Bhatt was spotted heading to the Cannes Film Festival, effectively quashing rumors that she would skip the event. She was seen at Mumbai airport early Friday morning
description: Alia Bhatt was seen leaving Mumbai airport early on Friday, heading to the Cannes Film Festival. This appearance dispelled rumors that she would skip the festival due to India-Pakistan tensions. Alia is making her debut at Cannes this year and is planned to participate in various events including the closing ceremony.
content_summary: Alia Bhatt has confirmed her attendance at the Cannes Film Festival 2025 by being spotted departing from Mumbai airport, dispelling the rumors that she might skip the event amid the ongoing India-Pakistan border tensions. Although she missed the opening day as a gesture of sensitivity to the conflict, her eventual travel to Cannes signals her participation in the festival. She is set for her debut at Cannes, including the closing ceremony appearances. Her presence has been welcomed by fans and the film community, marking an important milestone in her international career.
